* [Root Cause & Mechanism] AI's demonstrated capacity for systematic reasoning beyond traditional computational limits
* [Key Fact Detail] AI reasoning capabilities surpass individual mathematical proofs.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Implications for P vs NP and potential disruptions in cryptography.

- Primary Source: Bloomberg (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-26/sap-weighs-cutting-at-least-10-000-positions-in-ai-restructuring)
- Executive Summary: SAP CEO Christian Klein and CFO Dominik Asam are evaluating a restructuring plan to cut at least 10,000 positions, aiming to accelerate the firm's pivot toward cloud and AI-oriented roles. This initiative deviates from the previous 'Project Mongoose' strategy, which targeted incremental 1-2% annual workforce reductions to address execution lags in the earlier 'Next Level Transformation' program.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Christian Klein (CEO) and Dominik Asam (CFO) of SAP (Internal corporate restructuring): Considering cutting at least 10,000 roles to accelerate AI/cloud transition
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Previous transformation execution fell behind; radical structural adjustment needed for productivity
* [Key Metrics] Plan to cut at least 10,000 roles, roughly 10% of global headcount.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Core focus shifted to AI-driven productivity gains in cloud services.

### UK workers at Rockstar Games vote against a union recognition deal, with only 25% voting in favor; source: 1,544 employees, or 93.2% of eligible workers, voted (Chris Kerr/Vertical Slice)
- Canonical URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/abcfeb7a75c7d4cb
- Primary Source: Vertical Slice (https://www.verticalslice.news/rockstar-workers-vote-against-historic-union-recognition-deal/)
- Executive Summary: 1,544 employees at Rockstar Games UK voted against recognizing the Rockstar Game Workers Union (RGWU) as their official bargaining body. Despite the high-profile launch of GTA VI, 75% of voters rejected the proposal, meaning management remains under no obligation to engage in formal union negotiations.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Rockstar Games UK employees; RGWU; IWGB (UK video game sector): Voted against union recognition with a 75% 'no' result, blocking formal bargaining rights
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Preference for direct management-employee relations and lack of consensus on union value proposition
* [Key Metrics] Rockstar UK employees rejected union recognition with 75% voting against.
* [Official Stance & Demand] Formal negotiation requirements are off the table, with the union maintaining non-recognized status.

### Show HN: Neui – Go web apps with a built-in AI agent

- Primary Source: Hacker News (https://github.com/doors-dev/neui)
- Executive Summary: Neui has launched an integrated stack that combines a Go-based web framework (Doors) with an AI agent. By allowing developers to annotate UI elements, the agent can interact with the page, execute backend scripts, and automate workflows natively without the need for additional API layers or state synchronization.
- Key Verified Facts:

* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To eliminate the friction of building API-heavy AI agents by binding UI logic directly to backend tools.
* [Key Technical Spec] Uses Doors framework for single-stack execution of Go apps and AI agents.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Optimizes context caching to reduce operational costs for AI-driven interactions.

### Avicena, which links AI chips with microLEDs instead of lasers, raised a $100M+ Series C led by Intervest, with participation from SK Hynix, Samsung, and AMD (Cristian Dina/The Next Web)
- Canonical URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/47698e1a3ddee53f
- Primary Source: The Next Web (https://thenextweb.com/news/avicena-100m-series-c-microled-optical-interconnects-ai)
- Executive Summary: Sunnyvale-based Avicena has raised over $100M in Series C funding, led by InterVest with participation from SK Hynix, Samsung, and AMD. The company's LightBundle platform utilizes MicroLED arrays instead of traditional lasers to address bandwidth and power bottlenecks in data movement between processors and memory in AI clusters.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Avicena (CEO Kevin Pope), InterVest, SK Hynix, Samsung, AMD (AI data center infrastructure): Raised $100M+ Series C to scale LightBundle, a MicroLED-based optical interconnect
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To overcome physical limitations of copper interconnects regarding energy, density, and reach
* [Key Metrics] Avicena raised over $100M in Series C to scale LightBundle platform.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Strategic investment from AMD, SK Hynix, and Samsung validates its potential for future memory interconnects.
